transcript.t: My family has lived in the Green Park community for two years. It is a clean and quiet place.
There is a small garden in the middle, and old people often sit there and talk.
Every Sunday, the neighbours get together to clean up the rubbish near the gate.
Last month, I helped them for the first time. I put the rubbish into different bins.
After the work, a neighbour gave us cold watermelon.
I love my community, because everyone is friendly and ready to help.
